title: Dog Night, 2008 · after
logline: The Monday after nine years: Wood at Gully's asking, sideways, if the Lanes got a new manager. Gully says the Lanes got a new bulb. Wood says he saw. Gully pours. The strip lets the reader decide who climbed the ladder.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the stool. GULLY with the pot. BARNABY.
